native.effect: Call a unique CR15+ celestial, elemental, or outsider to aid you.

retainedSelectedLocalClauses.identity: Same existing individual; no generated generic substitute; unique reservation after eligibility.
retainedSelectedLocalClauses.admission: Current availability, willingly agreeing to exact aid, source location/custody, perceived supported body-fit destination, actual legal caster/components/resources.
retainedSelectedLocalClauses.commit: Source-correct Action/RP/cadence/concentration/counter history; no refund from later failure.
retainedSelectedLocalClauses.agency: Cooperative aid using own existing initiative/resources/abilities, no control or hidden-knowledge grant, no extra turn or generated-companion cap.
retainedSelectedLocalClauses.conservation: No copied body, renewed HP/uses/recharge/equipment or invented loot.
